title: 1389: Fix PLayerLog marker styles
body:
Fixes #1389 

For this issue, I updated:
- increate player log modal width to 50px 
- add min width css property for the marker
- in case the text content of the cell is too long, the scroll x auto appear to view all the text if need.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26705621/158003059-1b6691cf-9a27-4fc1-b323-4069f3672f76.mov

issues.title: Reactive Online Marker
issues.body:
The online/offline marker is reactive to the text box next to it. It squeezes or expands depending on if the text box says "a few seconds ago" or "X minutes ago".

![A Few Seconds Ago Bug](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/157252613-31e51ad2-f81b-4c2c-b04f-d9c9caae55eb.png)

![A Minute Ago Bug](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/157252640-e707434e-1749-4d58-90da-3c7f072f07eb.png)

Could we make the text box a two-liner so it doesn't impact the marker?

comments.body:
Wondering whether it's a font issue? I noticed that the Role and Last Active fonts might not be the same:

![Role Font Message Channel](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/157254456-54ff1ba9-5d49-4c90-a9d9-69790958d4ee.png)

![Last Active Font Message Channel](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/157254491-c93b3caf-ef09-4fad-8068-47538f7863d7.png)

Also, apparently, Chrome considers the offline marker as the same element as the text box. Maybe they need to be separate?

Another solution is to take more control of the column widths.  I'm sure we can reduce `Force` and `Sent at`. Hmm, or we make the dialog 50px (approx) wider. Then the `Last active` column will fit without squashing the icon.
I think the simple solution is set the min-width for the marker, it does not touch too much on the component code based 🤔
the marker works well but the text seems to be cut off. we can increase the column width a bit but I wonder if other columns has the long text, so we should support responsive column width here 🤔

I was playing around with the deployment in #1407 and I noticed that the Message column has the smallest text box info. I thought maybe we could shrink that one, but then I noticed this: 

I sent a message with BLUE 1 CO on the Message Channel (VHF C16):

![Message Channel Blue 1 CO](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/158013886-dbbb2301-7b1f-4818-bdc8-4c6e50301cae.png)

The player log seems to show that a message has been sent in "Chat", the same as when a message is sent in the general chat:

![Player Log Message Column Shows Chat instead of VHF C16](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/158013898-c0d51061-773d-49d5-b56a-94fe036618eb.png)

I would assume that when a player sends a message in the channels, it's a different item than the general chat message? 
In this example, should we show "VHF C16" in the message column in the player log?

I understand the confusion @ShendMikullovci 

We are displaying the message-type rather than the channel.  So, the game you're looking at has the `VHF C16` and `Admin` both configured to send `Chat` messages.  We _could_ switch to showing the channel name instead, but right now I don't think there is a right answer.  I suggest we live with it for a while and see.
